style.styleTitle: Homcom 6ft Christmas Tree with Pinecones and Red Berries
style.toneOfVoice: Bring natural forest elegance home with this 6 ft Christmas tree with decorations. Featuring dense PE and PVC branch tips pre-decorated with pine cones and red berries, it offers vibrant colour and realistic volume. Designed with a pre-attached hinged structure for quicker setup and crafted with flame-retardant materials, it provides cosy seasonal charm for young and fluffy friends. . Pre-decorated with natural-looking pine cones and red berries for instant festive charm; . Lifelike PE outer tips combined with dense inner PVC foliage offer realistic volume; . Pre-attached hinged system allows branch tips to drop open automatically; . Moulded PE branch tips always keep its shape and need little shaping; . Flame-retardant PE and PVC branch tips deliver high fire safety for family living spaces; . Strong metal base and sectioned trunk structure ensure reliable balance and easy storage; . Colour: Green, Red, Brown; . Material: PE, PVC, Metal; . Overall Dimensions: F111 x 180H cm; . Base Dimensions: F50 x 7.5H cm; . Branch Tip Count: 2843; . Item Label: 83C-284V00GN; . Note: Approx. 30-50 minutes of manual tip shaping recommended to achieve maximum natural fullness.; . Note: If you want to add extra decoration, use ribbons or other lightweight accents.
